newsitem.title: USA: Corrpro to take Q2 1997 charge for lawsuits.
newsitem.headline: Corrpro to take Q2 1997 charge for lawsuits.

text.p: Corrpro Cos Inc said Thursday it has reached an agreement in principle settling a securities class action lawsuit and shareholder derivative lawsuits, leading to a charge of about $2.4 million to be taken in the 1997 second quarter ended September 30.

The total amount of the proposed settlement is $6.075 million. The company said it has agreed to pay $1,137,500 in cash, to issue a $500,000 promissory note, and to pay an additional $1.4 million cash or equity securities valued at the time of distribution.
Corrpro said its insurer has agreed to pay the balance of the settlement.

The lawsuits were filed last year after the company's earnings for the 1995 fiscal year were announced. The settlement is subject to negotiation and the signing of a definitive agreement, as well as court approval.
The exact nature of the lawsuits could not immediately be determined.
Corrpro provides corrosion control engineering services, systems and equipment to the infrastructure, environmental and energy markets.
